name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション 浪人ギロロロボ
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Ronin Giroro Robo

description.ja: 荒武者を彷彿とする“浪人ギロロロボ”戦国ラン星に参上！
description.en: “Ronin Girororobo”, who is reminiscent of Aramusha, has arrived at Sengoku Ran!

description.ja: 巨大な右腕はフレキシブルに可動し、力強いポージングが再現可能。
description.en: The huge right arm can be flexibly moved to recreate powerful poses.

description.ja: パーツの組み換えで鉄拳砲撃形態に変形。
description.en: Transforms into Tekken bombardment form by rearranging parts.

description.ja: 浪人ギロロが乗った木馬型ソーサーは着脱可能。
description.en: The wooden horse-shaped saucer that Ronin Giroro rides on is removable.
